decisions.reason: The infectious waste decontamination plant builds on the firm's modular WASTX machinery know-how and on the ERMAFA partnership, so the firm can still interpret early market results and improve the product, although its regulated niche market carries some risk.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant extends the firm's core decentralized recycling systems and also serves as their pretreatment stage, so the firm can readily absorb customer feedback and refine it with its own R&D.
